abilities.name: Bull Charge
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. Add the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

abilities.name: Crush the Unworthy
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for each **daemonic power point** it has.
